title: The strike
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Generate a NEW composition for the THIRD panel of a Loopforge comic storyboard. This is the CYAN STRIKE / BOB FALLS shot. It must look radically different in CAMERA ANGLE, CROP, BODY POSES and composition from the wide greeting. Use reference1 ONLY for identities (approved ensemble), reference2 for detailed worker identities, reference3 for room material/architecture. Do NOT reproduce any group-pose arrangement.
CINEMATOGRAPHY: put the camera very low, about 25 cm above the floor BESIDE BOB, looking diagonally up and along the Security threshold with a wide 24mm lens. Foreground bob spans the bottom half of the frame diagonally, feet foreshortened toward one bottom corner and enormous fly-eye head nearer the other. His body is twisting as he FALLS ONTO HIS SIDE; one open hand is coming down hard towards the floor while the other is losing his ID. Give the gesture a strong tumbling diagonal, not a seated pose. He is the little slender blue worker with giant cyan fly-eye lenses on a flat tiny head. Clearly an adult industrial robot, not a baby.
LIMEN towers above him in the MIDGROUND slightly right of center, three-quarter PROFILE, heavy PALE STEEL security-chief body, looking DOWN at bob. LIMEN's anatomical RIGHT forearm finishes a LOW horizontal cyan-energy sweep across the space bob's leg occupied. His hips have turned through the short strike; one heavy boot has advanced, free left arm counterbalances. This is an actual changed action pose, not the greeting's upright stop pose. A brief cyan arc at bob's knee tells the single electrical contact; no gore, severing, dismemberment or destroyed worker. Blade is BUILT INTO RIGHT FOREARM, not held like a sword.
sam LUNGES INTO THE SHOT FROM NEAR LEFT, half-kneeling, enormous ROUND-HUMP shoulders leaning toward bob, one hand reaching to catch bob's upper arm but not quite there, the other bracing sam's own weight. sam's body is partially cropped by the near-left edge; this should feel like something happening fast beside the viewer, not a cast lineup.
BACKGROUNDS SHOW DIFFERENT DEPTHS AND REACTIONS: jo in a broad cap and work jacket has recoiled to a doorjamb, one hand still gripping an ID. Compact rectangular-headed mae turns side-on with one elbow raised protectively; Popeye-forearmed kit (PIPE, normal short neck) pulls back, his heavy forearms brought against his chest. ed, the lean swept-back skull goon, is caught between reaching for sam's sleeve and looking at LIMEN. Square broad gus holds his ID rigidly against his chest deeper in the room. These five witnesses appear at varying depths and angles, a few partly occluded/cropped; NO orderly row. The remaining workers are outside this shot's tighter view. Do NOT add lou clones, repeated heads or extra people. No STILETTO, no CATHEXIS yet.
Environment same cramped industrial Lobby/Security doorway: gray-blue floor #A7B2D3 in dramatic perspective, low reflections of cyan strike, security desk corner behind LIMEN, steel wall pipes and doorway uprights rising above, strip of warm exterior light at far left. Pale supervisor, blue workers, teal security light. Same painterly comic concept-art finish, fine machinery, bold legible silhouette. Wide landscape16:9.
EXACTLY THREE SPEECH BALLOONS, no captions. Bold jagged at top beside LIMEN, tail to his profile: "HEY YOU I SAID STOP!!!!" Small broken balloon immediately beside bob's head, tail to bob: "You said first—" Short urgent balloon near sam: "bob!" Layout must support the body diagonals without hiding hands, blade, eyes or the ID. This is the violent interruption viewed from bob's level, NOT another wide shot of workers facing a standing LIMEN.
visualReview: Distinct floor-level composition: bob across the foreground, sam reaching from near left, LIMEN looking down after a right-forearm cyan sweep; witnesses staggered in depth. Replaces the rejected greeting-like wide strike composition.
animationDirection: Cut to bob's low three-quarter view before the strike; preserve approach/contact/fall continuity. bob remains on the ground through ed/gus checks and STILETTO's entrance.
